/*selectMasterMpSoPrewarhsngRequestOrderMapppingPopList*/ SELECT ROWNUM NUM, X.PO_NO, X.PO_SEQ, X.DESCRIPTION, X.MAKER_NAME, X.ITEM_QTY, X.UNIT_MEASURE, X.UNIT_PRICE, X.REQ_DEPT_NAME, X.SPECIFICATION, X.ORIGIN_NAME, X.AGENT_NAME, X.AGENT_PRICE, X.REQ_USER_NAME, X.BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM ( SELECT B.PO_NO AS PO_NO, B.PO_SEQ, B.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, B.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, B.ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY, B.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, B.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE='KRKEPB0004' AND TYPE='C001' AND CODE=C.REQ_DEPT) AS REQ_DEPT_NAME, B.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE=B.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NAME, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, B.AGENT_PRICE AS AGENT_PRICE, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=C.REQ_USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_NAME, B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM ICOMPOHD A, ICOMPODT B, ICOMPRDT C WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND A.AGENT IN (SELECT COM_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || #{st_agent_name} || '%')
AND B.REF_PR_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_ref_pr_no} || '%'
AND (B.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%#%' OR B.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%')
AND B.MAKER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{st_maker_name} || '%'
AND C.REQ_USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || #{st_req_user_name} || '%')
AND A.STATUS ^='D' AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO=B.PO_NO AND B.STATUS ^='D' AND B.BUYER=C.BUYER AND B.PR_NO=C.PR_NO AND B.PR_SEQ=C.PR_SEQ AND C.STATUS ^='D' ORDER BY B.BUYER, B.PO_NO DESC, B.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) X
